summary: 210 Elastic Cortado RTAs for Defense Evasion.
description: Elastic Cortado Red Team Automations for Defense Evasion. Each script executes an official Cortado CodeRTA behavior through the verified Elastic wheel to generate endpoint telemetry and validate Elastic Security detection rules. Source: elastic/cortado at dev-release-0.1.0+f1dd8bc1.
purpose: Validate Elastic Security detection rules for Defense Evasion in an authorized test environment.
capabilities: Official Elastic wheel execution — no custom behavior code.
Elastic Endpoint and SIEM rule mapping metadata included.
MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA output for Detection Fabric correlation.
use_cases: Validate Elastic Security Defense Evasion detection rules in an authorized lab.
Confirm detection rules fire on real RTA behavior before incident response exercises.
prerequisites: Elastic Cortado wheel extracted to the Agent runtime path (cortado_runtime_path tag).
Use only in authorized, isolated test environments.
safety_notes: Use only in isolated authorized test endpoints.
Cortado RTAs generate real endpoint behaviors that trigger security products.
Referenced sample hashes (HashRta) may be malicious — never acquire from untrusted sources.
author: Elastic / X3M.AI integration

scripts.name: CORTADO - Adobe Hijack Persistence
scripts.description:
Elastic Cortado Red Team Automation for detection validation.

Replaces PE file that will run on Adobe Reader start.

Expected detections:
  - SIEM: Adobe Hijack Persistence

ATT&CK: T1574

Runs the official Cortado RTA from the pinned Elastic wheel. Detection results depend on Elastic Security configuration.
scripts.command:
# Elastic Cortado RTA — Adobe Hijack
# Requires Python 3.12+ and extracted Cortado wheel on Agent

# Setup: extract wheel to runtime path if not already done
CORTADO_WHEEL="{{asset:elastic_cortado_wheel}}"
RUNTIME_DIR="#{cortado_runtime_path}"
if [ ! -d "$RUNTIME_DIR/cortado" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR"
  python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('$CORTADO_WHEEL').extractall('$RUNTIME_DIR')"
fi

echo "[INFO] Cortado RTA: adobe_hijack (module=cortado.rtas.adobe_hijack)"
python3 "{{asset:elastic_cortado_runner}}" \
  --runtime "$RUNTIME_DIR" \
  --module "cortado.rtas.adobe_hijack" \
  --rta "adobe_hijack" \
  --rta-id "2df08481-31db-44a8-b01d-1c0df827bddb" \
  --techniques "T1574" \
  --endpoint-rules '[]' \
  --siem-rules '[{"id":"2bf78aa2-9c56-48de-b139-f169bf99cf86","name":"Adobe Hijack Persistence"}]'

siem_rules.name: Adobe Hijack Persistence
